name: Shenzhen Fortune Trend Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Fortune Trend Technology Co., Ltd. supplies securities market trading system software and securities information services in China and internationally. It offers software products, such as market analysis systems, securities trading systems, and intelligent service systems; maintenance services, including daily software maintenance and upgrades, emergency support, irregular return visits, technical consultation, and technical training; and securities information services comprising authorized market information services and financial data services. Shenzhen Fortune Trend Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2007 and is based in Shenzhen, China.
